tasks.title: Prove A and B effect equivalence without enabling B
tasks.goal: Exercise exact-plan authorization across both execution branches and denial boundaries.
steps: Run the same prepared subject through an A approval and an explicitly enabled test-only B policy using the same fake writer.
Compare ordered effect calls and independently observed post-state; vary scope, principal, epoch, expiry and revocation one at a time.
Exercise skipped smoke as a distinct authorized plan; confirm production defaults remain A.
positive_cases: Equivalent authorized A/B plans have identical external effects.
Explicitly skipped smoke is accepted without a pass claim.
negative_cases: Out-of-scope or revoked B has zero effects.
An A approval for the pre-skip/pre-change plan cannot authorize the changed plan.
acceptance: Evidence contains both authorization paths and equal effect traces.
No test edits real policy or enables live B.
tasks.safe_stop: Parity and refusal suite passes in isolated adapters.
tasks.commit_subject: test(publish): prove exact-plan authority parity and refusal
notes: Registration perimeter includes existing crate manifests and module owners only for required exports/dependencies; do not change unrelated declarations.

tasks.title: Exercise native and remote failure recovery
tasks.goal: Close release failure modes with real native smoke evidence and isolated restoration rehearsals.
steps: Consume the native smoke harness and root-provided native receipts; verify target/bundle/producer subjects before using them.
Inject failure at each publication effect boundary and during restoration; inspect resulting resources independently of the writer report.
Record evidence matrix for native failure, unavailable executor, retained rollback state and foreign interference; keep missing mandatory proof open.
positive_cases: Each completed native target supplies exact artifact evidence.
Supported prior-release restoration is verified after an interrupted replacement.
negative_cases: Cross-target or forged receipt cannot fill a native gap.
An incomplete restoration or unavailable executor is never marked successful.
acceptance: Every promised failure boundary has an observed outcome and recovery disposition.
No pending native evidence is replaced with a skipped-success summary.
tasks.safe_stop: Local failure matrix and available receipts are ready for parent review; outstanding hosts remain explicit.
tasks.commit_subject: test(dist): verify native failures and release restoration
notes: No public release/repository mutation. Receipt collection on another executor is an explicit root-managed task, not a claim inferred from source tests.
Registration perimeter includes existing crate manifests and module owners only for required exports/dependencies; do not change unrelated declarations.
